decision: After reporting a Delta Force download on df-repo.bytes.tcdnos.com and discussing the broader CDN boundary, the repository owner explicitly chose to put the whole bytes.tcdnos.com suffix into the game-download group.

runtime_observation.reported_activity: The user reported that Delta Force currently used this host for downloads.
runtime_observation.source: User report in this chat; no packet capture or download URL was supplied.
runtime_observation.first_match_method: Repository first_match simulation in both products; not a live gateway observation.

dns_observations.method: HTTPS DNS JSON A queries; the local system resolver returned fake-IP addresses and was not used for CDN address evidence.
dns_observations.namespace_apex: bytes.tcdnos.com returned NXDOMAIN for A at review time; the suffix rule still matches the apex if it becomes active.
dns_observations.limits: DNS responses are time- and location-dependent snapshots. Canonical names and addresses establish the observed delivery chain, not the purpose of every host. No destination-IP rule is added.

boundary.selection: Explicit owner-approved routing policy for bytes.tcdnos.com and all its subdomains, including future or otherwise unobserved hosts.
boundary.excluded_sibling_example: df-repo.aly.tcdnos.com is a boundary-test example, not an observed download host.
boundary.policy_override: The download group remains manually selectable; DIRECT is its existing default.

verification_limits: Exclusive gaming use of the bytes namespace and Honor of Kings use were not established. Public search and certificate-transparency lookup did not establish a complete host inventory. Post-change client reachability and download performance remain untested.
